The ability to make decisions and live one's life without external influences can be seen as a reflection of the trust and power granted to individuals by Allah. This name may also be linked to the concept of Tawheed, or monotheism, as it emphasizes the idea that one's allegiance and obedience belong only to Allah and not to any worldly authority.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Wildan can be seen as an invitation to strive for spiritual independence and self-reliance. It can serve as a reminder to seek guidance and strength from Allah rather than relying on others or accumulating material possessions. The spiritual significance of the name also lies in the fact that it highlights the importance of trusting in Allah's divine plan and not being restrained by fear or doubt. This can lead to greater spiritual growth and the ability to fully surrender to the will of Allah.
